# AIX execution Composer fixture

This independent package declares default, Session, Run and Turn normalization
actions through canonical ACL. Run follows the current native Core Run observation.
Turn follows its current model-call ordinal; it is not a Core Tool Turn capability.
Missing or disconnected observations withdraw execution-scoped actions while
session actions and the input draft remain available.

The archive builder bundles index.html and provider.js from composer-normalize.
The shared executable provider receives only bounded draft text, revision and a
private request identity. No Core Run, session, workspace or host grant is sent.

```sh
node scripts/build-aix-proof.mjs /tmp/composer-execution.aix composer-execution
```

This fixture does not qualify real native HTTP, PG/RustFS or WebView security.
